source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of financial concepts (PDF 217).

blocks.text: Paisa samajhna behtar faisle karne aur karobar barhane mein madad deta hai, chahe chhoti dukaan ho ya bari company. Yeh hissa revenue aur profit, kharche aur budget, sarmayakari aur bachat, aur qarz aur sood samjhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Maali tasawwurat entrepreneurs ki kis cheez mein madad karte hain (MCQ 8)?
blocks.explanation: (b) wasail sambhalna aur tarraqi ka mansooba.

items: Maali tasawwurat: revenue, profit, budget, sarmayakari, bachat, qarz aur sood.
